name: Yuri (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Yuri town emblem in white: a ring flanked by leaf-like strokes enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Yuri in Akita Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-22. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 1960.

features.role: Yuri town emblem — a ring flanked by leaf-like strokes enclosing a stylised character
